name: Commercial Harbor

special.name: commercial_harbor
special.note: Grey hex with a crane tower, OFF the 9-column grid: bottom-left corner, touching the lower-left edge of [0,5] (partly under the left-edge panel). Not a playable cell. Active once connected: once per turn discard 1 hand card for 3 money.

special_spaces.name: harbor_connecting_building_space
special_spaces.note: Only grid hex touching the harbor; a building on it connects the harbor.

uncertain: Harbor connecting space [0,5] inferred from adjacency (harbor hex is clipped by the left panel); no explicit marker on any grid hex.
First yellow (once) left-edge token is a grey pillared-building icon (same icon as plan6 cell [7,1]); meaning unknown, named university.
Bonus 'multiplier' at [7,2] is a dark-purple pentagon with 'multiplier'; meaning unknown.
rep1 at [0,2] is a graduation-cap icon with 1 (plan0's rep2 is the same cap with 2).
notes: Grid shape matches Map 0 (6/7/6/7/6/7/6/7/6 hexes per column). Left edge: only 3 purple tokens (no conservation 1) plus an extra first yellow token (grey building icon). Partner slot4, university slot3 and last-worker-3 give conservation 1 (Map 0: 2). New bonuses vs Map 0: rep1, multiplier. Lake [1,2],[2,1],[2,2],[3,2].

identified.sponsor_for_money: coin marked X beside a blue '@' card: play a sponsor card from hand by paying its level (official FAQ: from hand only, not the display)
identified.university: grey pillared building: gain a university
identified.multiplier: x2: multiplier token on an action card (as the bonus tile)
identified.upgrade_PROBABLE: card with a circular arrow, red/blue stripe: read as upgrade an action card; not confirmed by a written source
identified.animal_silhouette_2_UNKNOWN: map 7 purple token: half-dark animal silhouette with 2; meaning unknown
